title: Admin route reachable without the owner check
description: The privileged /admin handler is registered outside the guard that covers the other routes.
root_cause: The auth middleware is applied per-route and the admin route was added after the wiring block.
intended_behavior: Every privileged route requires an allow-listed caller.
evidence: Read at the stated lines; no guard between entrypoint and sink.
conditions: Any caller who can reach the port.
remediation: Register the route behind the same guard, or default-deny in the router.

title: Login endpoint may have no rate limit
description: No limiter is visible in the handler, but the deployment may add one at the proxy.
claimed_root_cause: Throttling is assumed to be handled upstream.
evidence: No limiter in the handler; proxy config is not in the repo.
blockers: proxy configuration is not in the repository
validation_plan: Inspect the deployment's ingress config, or run a bounded local loop against a fixture.

title: Possible SQL injection in the query builder
description: A string-built query looked suspicious at first read.
evidence: The concatenated fragment is a fixed column name from a closed allowlist; values are bound.
reason: Disproved: the interpolated part is a compile-time constant chosen from an allowlist, not attacker-controlled.
